brief.background: Heritage: the purity that gives your child strength.

options.text: Purity you can see. Strength you can watch grow.
options.note: Bets on visible proof both ways — purity as demonstrable, strength as observable in the child over time; leans into the demo layer competitors can't match.

options.text: The purest milk builds the strongest kids.
options.note: Bets flatly on the SMP causal chain — purity leads to strength — aimed at the outcome-focused parent; simplest, most repeatable, most contestable by Amul/Mother Dairy.

options.text: No compromise in the glass. No limit on the child.
options.note: Bets on the 'will not compromise' parent identity from positioning — purity is the parent's non-negotiable, strength is the child's open future; owns the emotional stance not the product fact.

options.text: Har boond mein shakti — kyunki har boond shudh hai.
options.note: Bets on the vernacular South/Hindi idiom and the master idea directly — every drop carries strength because every drop is pure; strongest for on-ground and mass, weakest for premium modern-trade shelf.
